<entry id="O01112">
<head-word>סַמְמָן</head-word>
<head-word>סַמָּן</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> c. (v. 
<xref rid="O01049">סַם</xref>) 
<italic>drug</italic>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>ingredient of frankincense</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Yoma IV, 41
<sup>d</sup> bot. (expl. חציים) חצי כל ס' וס' a fraction of each ingredient.—
<plural-form>Pl. סַמְמָנִים, סַמְמָנִין, סַמָּנִ'</plural-form>. Ib. 41
<sup>d</sup>; Ker. 6
<sup>a</sup> סַמְמָנֶיהָ, v. חָסַר. Ib. אחד מסַמְמָנֵי הקטרת one of the ingredients of the frankincense; a. fr.—Y. Sabb. XII, 13
<sup>c</sup> bot. ליטע סִימְמָנִין to plant the spices for the frankincense.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>pl.</italic> as above: 
<italic>paint, dye, colors</italic>; in gen. 
<italic>artist’s material</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 1 צייר … שמצא ס' וכ' your god is a great artist, but he found good material which helped him. Num. R. s. 12; Ex. R. s. 35, a. e. אתה בסַמְמָנֶיךָ וכ' thou (paint it) with thy materials, but I appear in my glory myself; Yalk. Ex. 369 בסַמָּנֶיךָ; Pesik. Vayhi, p. 5
<sup>a</sup> בסימנך (corr. acc.). B. Kam. 101
<sup>a</sup> שבח ס' the value of the dye (additional to that of the wool); a. fr.—[Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. III, 13 סממנין, v. סִמְלוֹן.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>Pi.</italic> סִימֵּן (denom. of סִימָן) 
<italic>to mark</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Koh. R. to XII, 10, [read:] שלש סימנים סִימַּנְתִּי לך בקבורתו וכ' (וסיימתי לך, being a gloss) three signs did I mark out for thee with regard to the grave of Moses; Midr. Till. to Ps. IX (not סימנתין).—Part. pass. מְסוּמָּן; pl. מְסוּמָּנִים, מְסוּמָּנִין. B. Bath. X, 7 (172
<sup>a</sup>) אם היו מ' (Y. ed. אם היו בסימנין; Ms. M. אם היו סימנין, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) if the two persons of the same name bear also the same marks.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>sapphire</italic>, 
<italic>lapislazuli</italic> (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Sapphir).</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 26 ושל סמ' היו וכ' and they (the tablets) were lapislazuli, and yet they were like a light object in his hands; Cant. B’shall. 21 המטה של סמפר' היה the staff (of Moses) was of sapphire; Ex. R. s. 8. Pesik. ʿĂniya, p. 135
<sup>b</sup> נאה כס' הזה beautiful like sapphire. Ib. סמפ י̇ר̇ו' (corr. acc.); Pesik. R. s. 32; (Lam. R. to IV, 7 סַפִּיר); a. fr.—
<italic>Chald.</italic> Targ. Y. Deut. IV, 13. Ib. XXXIV, 12.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>Hif.</italic>) the wine will surely make him red (excite him). Y. Ḥag. II, 77

<italic>Part. pass.</italic> מְסַמַּק; 
<plural-form>pl. מְסַמְּקִין, מְסַמְּקֵי</plural-form>. Targ. Ex. XXVI, 14. Targ. Nah. II, 4; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<italic>to become</italic> or 
<italic>be dark red</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 93
<sup>b</sup>; Pes. 74
<sup>b</sup> אומצא דא' a piece of meat which is dark red (from congested blood). Ib. בין א' בין לא א' whether the fluid looks red; a. e.</notes></sense>

<italic>a sort of shoe for the legs of a bedstead</italic>; [Ar.: 
<italic>a board placed under a short leg</italic>]. Ohol. XII, 4; Tosef. ib. XIII, 4.—Yeb. 103
<sup>b</sup> ס' של נחת ע"ז Ar. (ed. ס' של ע"ז) the shoe for the rest of an idol.—

<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>a flat fish</italic> like 
<italic>the sole</italic> or 
<italic>turbot</italic>; trnsf. 
<italic>a flat, fish-shaped abortion</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Nidd. III, 4 המפלת ס' וכ' a woman who discharges a sandal-like foetus or a placenta. Tosef. ib. IV, 7 ס' שאמרו דומה לס' דג שבים the sandal abortion of which they speak means a foetus resembling the sea-fish called sandal; [oth. opin.] דומה ללשון של שור resembling the fish called ‘oxtongue’ (βοὐγλοσσος, lingulaca); Y.ib. ib. III, 50
<sup>d</sup> bot.; Bab. ib. 25
<sup>b</sup>; a. e. [Snh. 59
<sup>b</sup> סנדלין Ms. M., v. סנְדֵּלְכוֹנִים.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>
